definitions.name: Dispersion Breakdown Index (DBI)
trigger: DBI > 3.0 sustained 5+ days while Nifty range < 1% = **regime change within 2 weeks (78% historical hit-rate, COVID + 2022 + 2024-election all had this signature)**.

definitions.name: Volume Herfindahl Index (Concentration)
trigger: HHI rises > 0.04 (top 5 stocks doing > 40% of volume) for 10+ days → correction setup.

definitions.name: Up-Volume to Down-Volume Decay
formula: `(sum vol on up days) / (sum vol on down days)` rolling 10d.
trigger: Ratio drops > 40% in 10 days while Nifty within 2% of high → top forming.

definitions.name: FII Index Futures Net Position Shift
formula: `FII_net_fut = FII_long_contracts - FII_short_contracts` (sum across Nifty + BankNifty futures).
trigger: Drop > 40% from 30d high in FII net long → correction within 10 days (high hit rate historically).

definitions.name: Put-Call Ratio (PCR) Skew Shift
trigger: PCR jumps > 30% from 20d average WITHOUT corresponding VIX rise = stealth hedging.

definitions.name: Nifty Futures Basis Anomaly
trigger: Basis turns negative for 3+ days when historically positive = institutional unwind. Lead time ~7 days.

definitions.name: F&O Ban List Size Expansion
trigger: Ban list > 12 stocks (vs typical 3-6) → mid-cap correction within 2 weeks.

definitions.name: Triple Safe-Haven Rally
trigger: All 3 conditions true for 5+ days simultaneously: gold +2%, USDINR +1%, 10Y yield -10bps.

definitions.name: USD/INR 50DMA Breakout (with confirmation)
trigger: Breakout + 3-day hold + FX volume confirmation.

definitions.name: Cross-Asset Correlation Spike
trigger: 20-day correlation rises > 0.6 from typical < 0.4.

definitions.name: GST Collection Trend
trigger: Monthly GST collection < 95% of 6m avg for 2 consecutive months → CORRECTION setup.

definitions.name: Bank Credit Growth Deceleration
trigger: Credit growth rate falls > 200bps month-on-month → defensive shift.

definitions.name: RBI G-Sec Auction Devolvement
trigger: Any auction devolvement event after 6+ months of clean auctions → liquidity warning.

definitions.name: MTF (Margin Trading Facility) Outstanding
trigger: MTF balance up > 15% MoM and at all-time highs → bubble warning.

definitions.name: Promoter Pledge Increase Cluster
trigger: > 20 companies with > 5% pledge increase in same 30d window → narrow risk-off.

definitions.name: Insider Sell-to-Buy Ratio (Sectoral)
trigger: Ratio > 4.0 in any sector for 30 days → that sector is exhausted, even if price still rising.

definitions.name: Promoter Fresh Buying Cluster (Bullish)
trigger: > 10 such transactions in 60d during a correction → bottom-fishing signal.

definitions.name: SIP Net Inflow Trend
trigger: Monthly SIP inflow drops > 10% MoM after 12+ months of growth → late-cycle.

definitions.name: Smart Beta Outflow
trigger: Low-vol ETF inflows > growth ETF inflows for 4 consecutive weeks during rally → defensive rotation.

definitions.name: FII Sectoral Flow Concentration
trigger: Concentration > 70% for 2 consecutive weeks → setup for sector-rotation crash.

definitions.name: Pre-Result Bias Signal
trigger: Stock fell > 2% on each of last 3 beat-quarters → exhausted, AVOID.

definitions.name: Budget / RBI MPC Drift
trigger: 10d pre-event return > +3% → reduce exposure; < -3% → opportunity.

definitions.name: Retail Volume Share Spike
trigger: Retail share > 60% for 10 days → distribution; < 35% in correction → bottom near.

definitions.name: New Demat Account Velocity
trigger: New accounts > 130% of trailing avg → top-of-cycle warning.

definitions.name: Social Media Stock Mention Velocity
trigger: Mention volume > 2 standard deviations above 90-day average → late-cycle.
source_claim: Google Trends, Twitter API (or proxy via news mentions).

definitions.name: NSE-BSE Volume Divergence
trigger: BSE share rises > 25% of total combined volume → late mid-cap cycle.

definitions.name: SME IPO Listing-Day Pop Distribution
trigger: 30d avg SME pop > 75% = top; falling below 30% = early correction signal.

definitions.name: Sub-Broker / Algo Account Growth
trigger: AP registrations > 150% of 12m average → late-cycle.

definitions.name: CPSE/PSU Disinvestment Pipeline Activation
trigger: 3+ OFS announcements in 30 days → reduce PSU exposure.

definitions.name: Mutual Fund Cash Allocation
trigger: Cash > 6% across top 20 schemes → MF expecting drawdown.

findings.detail: 1500 unique sequential G07 IDs, 324 non-future rows and 1176 reserved future rows. Current catalog has 175 IDs with zero exact overlap. Runtime loads the 175 catalog, not this archived registry. Source status ACTIVE and enabled=true do not establish a computation or approval.

All current_value fields are null and all hit_status values are NOT_EVALUATED. 1476 thresholds are null. 114 of 135 enabled rows have DATA_NEEDED sources, including 65 enabled undefined formula slots. 24 specific formula/operational rows use the generic source label sample/upload/API, not an identified current feed. Even those need units, warm-up/seed, zero-denominator, missing-data and exact band-boundary contracts.

The declared allowed value is DATA-NEEDED, but 186 records use DATA_NEEDED. Three ACTIVE rows are disabled: G07_0096, G07_0128 and G07_0139. Preserve both source facts rather than normalizing or activating them silently.

Archived profile max_position_pct 5 and max_open_positions 20 differs from current source policy maxPositionPct 10 and maxOpenPositions 500. Archived heat threshold 0.15 differs from current maxPortfolioHeatPct 25. G07_0236 embeds capital*max_position_pct but also carries threshold 0.05: percent-point versus fraction conversion and whether the formula returns a Boolean or a ratio require an explicit contract. Do not adopt source values or infer production state.

Example buy_contracts 45200 and sell_contracts 51800 gives buy-minus-sell=-6600, matching the supplied net_contracts example. The note says sell-minus-buy, which would be +6600. Import must not choose or reverse the sign without resolving this source contradiction.

Warning 4 defines FII long-contracts minus short-contracts positions across Nifty/BankNifty. G07_0128 defines futures buy-value minus sell-value transaction flow, with 500/100 bands whose currency unit is unstated in that row. Current NO09 instead specifies a 60-day z-score of net-position change and has no matching evaluator branch here. Transaction values, buy/sell contract flow and long/short open positions must not be substituted.

The 78% DBI hit-rate statement has no supporting observations/test output in these six members. The document ends by calling all 30 hypotheses and requires lead>5 sessions, true-positive rate>60%, false-positive rate<30% and 3+ events before adoption. DBI zero/near-zero index-return behavior, exact range construction, point-in-time constituents, release-time alignment and unseen-period validation are not fully specified.

HHI>0.04 is not equivalent to top-five volume share>40%. Counterexample: 20 names each carry 5% of volume and the other 180 carry0%; HHI=0.05 while top-five share=25%. Preserve the original trigger but do not treat its parenthetical as a proven identity.

SIP warning 18 asks for net inflow but feed 5 provides gross SIP. FX breakout warning 9 requires FX volume absent from feed 9; warning 10 needs S&P500 returns absent from feeds 8/9. A 10-day retail-share trigger is not established by the monthly publication frequency described in warning 23. Feed 8's instructed zero nifty_volume must remain an unavailable-volume sentinel rather than measured liquidity. Yield 7.02 is percentage points; a 10 bp move is 0.10 percentage point, not 10 raw units. Macroeconomic period and actual release dates need separate fields to prevent look-ahead.

13787 security-series records, not 13787 unique stocks or daily observations. Only 3365 rows carry EQ. Symbol+series is unique; symbols and ISINs repeat across series. Header declares JUN 2026 and count 013787, not a verified day-of-month. Category codes 1/2/3 and the final numeric field have no authoritative meaning/unit dictionary in scope.10154 final fields are blank and must not become zero. No price/volume/turnover/position unit or action sizing can safely be inferred.

1608 unique descending seven-position candles span 2018-01-01 to 2024-07-01. Numeric OHLC envelopes pass positional checks, but no instrument identity or request provenance is stored. All final two fields are zero. Mixed timestamp times include 2018-11-07T17:30 and 2018-07-23T09:51; preserve originals, do not classify as invalid non-trading days without a calendar. No import as IndiaVIX, equity OHLCV, current quote or liquidity evidence is approved.

Current NU08 catalog describes sector_value_after/portfolio_value_after<=0.25, but its evaluator uses (same-sector holding count+1)/(total holding count+1). Archived G07_0243 also describes value/capital, not counts. Three existing other-sector positions valued 100 each and a new-sector candidate valued 900 produce 25% by count versus 75% by value. The node contributes to tunnel evidence aggregation; this is a source-level mismatch, not proof of production execution, a primary-ranking change or a portfolio hard-gate bypass. Correction requires separate user discussion/approval.
